title: halo — open AirTag-compatible tracker
subtitle: Factory handoff pack
generated_note: Every row in this pack is generated from spec/release-pack.json by tools/gen_release_pack.py. Nothing here is hand-typed HTML.
audience: A partner factory and ten engineers. Plain English; the tables and drawings carry the load.
leif_verbatim: We have a Chinese guy working on this project and we will work together with all the resources and manufacturing and factories and research on this. We have a factory and 10 engineers to put on this. So just send the documents of what needs to be done. Give it this verbatim.
summary_en: halo is an open-source tracker that behaves like an Apple AirTag: it is found through Apple's Find My network, it makes a sound, a phone can tap it, and it wakes on motion. Every design file is public. This pack states exactly what is finished, what is not, and what we need a factory to measure that a computer cannot.
summary_zh: halo 是一个开源追踪器，功能对标 Apple AirTag：可通过 Apple Find My 网络定位、可发声、支持手机 NFC 触碰读取、运动唤醒。全部设计文件公开。本文件说明：哪些已完成、哪些未完成，以及哪些必须由工厂实测、计算机无法给出答案。

artifacts.name: Gerbers, drill and netlist
artifacts.reason: DO NOT FABRICATE, and the package is stale in two directions. Re-measured 2026-09-05 with a fresh check on both board files: the SOURCE board, which board.py regenerates, is UNROUTED at 3 warnings and 83 unconnected. The ROUTED board, a separate derived file, is at 3 warnings and 28 unconnected. The gerbers on disk are 7,742 s older than either and were cut before the coil keep-out and the plane clearing. So there are three artifacts here and no two of them describe the same copper. Worse, the design-rule report in the release pack was 17,616 seconds — 4.9 hours — older than the board, and a stale gerber wastes a fabrication run while a stale rule-check reports PASS on a board that does not exist and everything downstream trusts it. Fresh reports are now in out/verify/drc-current.json and drc-routed-current.json. Three things must happen before this row moves: routing reaches zero unconnected on the routed board, board.py is reconciled so the source and routed files do not diverge, and the package is re-cut and passes a freshness gate against the board it came from.
artifacts.evidence: out/verify/drc-current.json (source, 83 unconnected) and drc-routed-current.json (routed, 28); gerbers 7,742 s older than both

artifacts.name: Bill of materials with prices and alternates
artifacts.name_zh: 物料清单（含价格与替代料）
artifacts.reason: Closed 2026-09-05. The recorded failure was an IDENTITY defect, not an availability one, and it was already fixed: the old bill of materials had an 8-pin screw terminal block sitting on four capacitor pads and a 133 MHz oscillator in an inductor land. artifacts.name: Simulation evidence
artifacts.reason: Four circuit simulations pass with sourced assertions, and the electromagnetic solver has been validated against a published reference antenna to within 0.66 percent, which is what makes its other answers trustworthy. One honest exception is stated in the risks below: the two round-board antenna geometries pass their own tests while resonating outside the Bluetooth band, and are being retuned.

artifacts.name: Firmware, build instructions and a proven advertisement
artifacts.name_zh: 固件、编译说明与已验证的广播包
artifacts.reason: The firmware builds for all five target chips from one source tree and fits with enormous margin: 13,164 bytes of flash out of 1,036,288 on the nRF54L10, which is 1.27 percent, and 704 bytes of RAM out of 196,608. Rolling keys work on the tag with 15-minute rotation, verified against an independent reference that shares no code with the firmware. Both networks advertise concurrently in the same advertising event, and the Google side had to be written from the published specification because no open implementation of the tag side existed anywhere. One honest gap: the emulator models no nRF54L part at all, so the port is verified by ten static checks per board with a negative control rather than by running it.
artifacts.evidence: ce-fwsim — nRF54L10 13164 B flash / 704 B RAM; check-rollkey 11 PASS; check-fmdn 7 PASS; check-dult 16 PASS 1 CANNOT DETERMINE; committed eeda515e, 6637b37e, 72851c1c, 1e23cab6, 684e4f98
artifacts.command: ce-fwsim/bin/fwsim build --board nrf54l10 ; fwsim check-soc ; check-rollkey ; check-fmdn ; check-dult

artifacts.name: Mechanical files and assembly instructions
artifacts.reason: The enclosure is modelled and measured, not asserted: assembly 31.874 by 31.874 by 7.980 mm, matching Apple's drawing to a thousandth, with the maximum diameter falling at the height Apple's drawing puts it. Twelve checks pass, ten valid closed solids, 45 interference pairs clear, and every exported model was read back by an independent tool that knows nothing about the modeller. The bayonet door's compliance is measured by kernel probes rather than argued: dropped and twist-only both stay retained, press-and-twist frees it. Mass 7.8 g against the AirTag's 11 g, the difference being Apple's motor.

artifacts.name: Production test plan
artifacts.reason: Written, and generated from data rather than typed: 31 tests across three stations, 99 limits, every one naming the datasheet section, standard, decision or in-repo measurement it came from. The generator refuses to write the plan unless every test carries the sentence 'this could report PASS while ___ is badly wrong' and the assert that closes it. It is PARTIAL and not READY for one honest reason: 15 of the 87 gate limits have no source yet and say so with the measurement that would settle each. The largest is the production acoustic limit, because DULT's 60 Phon is a loudness level under ISO 532-1 and a sound level meter does not measure phon; that number comes from a golden unit measured in qualification, which the factory can do and we cannot.
artifacts.evidence: docs/TEST-PLAN.md; out/release/TEST-PLAN.html; spec/test-plan.json - 31 tests, 22 on every unit, 19 PASS / 12 CANNOT DETERMINE, 21/99 limits unsourced and each naming its fix; cycle 4.4 min per unit, takt 2.6 min

artifacts.reason: The legal and certification research is complete: an 867-line dossier with a 30-item constraint checklist covering trademarks, patents, the radio certification route, the anti-stalking standard and coin-cell child-safety law. parcels.acceptance: Measured against a calibrated meter at 25 cm, at three volts and at end-of-life cell voltage, reported in Phon per ISO 532-1:2017.
parcels.depends: A printed or moulded shell and a driven bender. Nothing else.
parcels.unblocks: Artifacts 8 and 9, and the anti-stalking compliance claim.

questions.q: Can you measure sound pressure against a calibrated meter?
questions.why: The anti-stalking standard mandates 60 Phon at 25 cm. We chose a bare piezo bender bonded to the shell because every housed buzzer is 3.5 mm tall and we have 1.5 mm. Whether that reaches the required loudness is a measurement, not a simulation, and it is the single largest open risk in the product.
questions.zh: 能否用校准声级计测量声压？防跟踪标准要求 25 cm 处 60 Phon。

questions.q: Does the Ø31.87 by 7.98 mm stack close in moulded plastic?
questions.why: A coin cell plus the internal module already consumes 6.5 mm of 7.98 mm. About 1.5 mm remains for the cover, clearances and shell wall.
questions.zh: Ø31.87 × 7.98 mm 的堆叠在注塑件中是否可行？

questions.q: What opening force does your bayonet tooling achieve?
questions.why: United States law requires a coin-cell compartment to need a tool or two independent simultaneous movements. A snap fit fails outright.
questions.zh: 卡扣式电池门的开启力是多少？

questions.q: What is your process capability on a Ø32 mm four-layer board?
questions.why: We need minimum trace and space, via drill and annular ring, edge clearance, and whether castellated edges are possible at this size, so we can encode them as automated checks.
questions.zh: Ø32 mm 四层板的工艺能力参数？

questions.q: Can you source the Nordic nRF54L10 at volume, and does a pre-certified module exist on it?
questions.why: This chip gives us centimetre-level ranging between our own devices for less money than the older part. If it cannot be sourced, that decision reverses.
questions.zh: 能否批量采购 nRF54L10？是否有基于该芯片的预认证模组？

questions.q: Do you have a network analyser for antenna measurement?
questions.why: Our solver is validated to within 0.66 percent of a published reference, but a simulated antenna is not a measured one.
questions.zh: 是否有矢量网络分析仪用于天线实测？

questions.q: Can you source a bare piezo bender of about 20 mm diameter and 0.2 mm thickness, and what is your bare-board price for a Ø31.87 mm four-layer panel?
questions.why: Two things our catalogue cannot answer. The sounder part we specified is not in the assembly catalogue at all, and the factory publishes no bare-board rate, so our cost model has a hand-entered number where it should have a quote.
questions.zh: 能否采购约 20 mm、0.2 mm 厚的裸压电片？Ø31.87 mm 四层板的裸板价格是多少？

questions.q: Which IPC-A-610 acceptance class do you build to, and can you measure loudness in phon rather than decibels?
questions.why: The inspection recipe is derived from the acceptance class and nobody has chosen one. And the anti-stalking standard's 60 Phon requirement cannot be gated on a line with a decibel meter until a reference unit is characterised in phon.
questions.zh: 贵厂按哪个 IPC-A-610 验收等级生产？能否以 phon（宋）而非分贝测量响度？

compliance.detail: Not on the product, the packaging, the documentation or the listing. Apple's guidelines bar even a phonetic equivalent or abbreviation. We may say the product is compatible with Apple's Find My network. We may not use the licensed 'Works with Apple Find My' badge, which requires a programme we have deliberately not joined.
compliance.zh: 任何位置不得使用 Apple 商标。

compliance.rule: No copied copper and no copied artwork
compliance.detail: Every trace in this design is drawn from datasheets and application notes. One excellent open reference board was deliberately not copied because its licence would have infected ours. Do not substitute layout from another product.
compliance.zh: 不得复制他人 PCB 布线或图形。

compliance.rule: The anti-stalking behaviour is in the bill of materials, not an option
compliance.detail: The sound maker, the accelerometer and the connectable advertisement are required by the industry standard that Apple and Google jointly authored. There is no silent build, no stealth firmware variant, and we will not produce one. A tag without a working sounder is a stalking device.
compliance.zh: 防跟踪功能属于必备物料，不可选配。

compliance.rule: The battery door must meet the coin-cell child-safety rule
compliance.detail: Products made or imported after 19 March 2024 must need a tool or two independent simultaneous movements to open the compartment, with warnings on product, packaging and manual.
compliance.zh: 电池仓门必须符合纽扣电池儿童安全法规。

compliance.detail: This design is clean-room, derived from a published academic paper and public reverse engineering. Anyone who has read Apple's accessory specification under its non-disclosure agreement must not contribute to the firmware.
compliance.zh: 严禁使用 Apple 保密资料。

compliance.detail: Hardware under CERN-OHL-S-2.0, firmware under AGPL-3.0-or-later, tools under Apache-2.0, documentation under CC-BY-SA-4.0. A factory manufacturing this must publish the sources of any hardware changes it makes.
compliance.zh: 授权条款：硬件 CERN-OHL-S-2.0，固件 AGPL-3.0+。

risks.r: A physical law had been turned into a tolerance
risks.d: The antenna's sanity check required an implied permittivity above 1, because a dielectric cannot speed a wave up. To admit a failing case, that floor had been widened to 0.64. The verification lane found it, and the number it was admitting came from a run that hit its timestep limit without converging and shows no reactance zero-crossing anywhere in the sweep — meaning there is no resonance at all, and the 2.425 GHz figure was not a resonance. Both the floor and the convergence table have been corrected. This is the exact prohibition the project runs on: a row closed by weakening its check is worse than an open row, because it stops anyone looking.

risks.r: The antenna does not yet resonate in the Bluetooth band
risks.d: Two round-board geometries return a passing verdict while resonating at 4.0 and 5.8 GHz, because their assertions test only how deep the match is and how efficient the radiator is, never the frequency. Caught by the orchestrator on 2026-09-03, the assertion is being made mandatory and the geometry retuned. This is stated here rather than hidden because a passing test that checks the wrong thing is the most dangerous artifact in any release pack.

risks.r: The sounder is unproven and legally required
risks.d: See question one. If a bonded bender cannot reach 60 Phon at 25 cm, the fallback is a micro-speaker, which costs more than the rest of the board.
Every result in this pack comes from a simulator or an emulator. Eight claims are tracked in docs/VERIFICATION-DEBT.md with the measurement that would close each; four of them need hardware.

risks.r: The sounder part is resolved (was: may not be buyable)
risks.d: Closed 2026-09-04. The Murata part D11a chose is obsolete with zero stock and delisted from LCSC. Replaced by Same Sky CEB-2021 at 0.21 mm, thinner than assumed so the stack is unaffected, 3,756 in stock, with two documented alternates. See DECISIONS.md D20. What remains open is not the part but its loudness, which only a measurement settles.

risks.r: Every gerber export had been failing silently
risks.d: The factory tooling lane found that a flag it passed to the board exporter does not exist in this version, so no gerber export had ever succeeded, while the pipeline reported success. Same defect class as the router that never ran and the antenna that asserted the wrong quantity — see docs/TOOLS-THAT-LIE.md. Found by measurement, not review.

risks.r: The mandated sound level has no production limit yet
risks.d: The anti-stalking standard specifies 60 Phon, which is a loudness level under ISO 532-1. A sound level meter does not measure phon; it measures decibels. So the production line's decibel gate has no anchor until a golden unit is measured in phon and correlated, which is a qualification task and a gauge study, not a line test. Until then the loudest requirement in the product is untestable on the line. This is the single sharpest open item in the pack.

risks.r: The flash sits on an unregulated coin-cell rail
risks.d: The revision A schematic puts the SPI flash on the raw CR2032 rail at 3.0 V, while the part is rated 1.65 to 2.0 V. Found by the test lane reading the schematic, not by a simulation. The board lane has been asked either to regulate it or to delete it — deleting is likely, since the entire firmware is 13,164 bytes and fits in 1.27 percent of the chip's own memory.

risks.r: Stock cover is thin at volume
risks.d: The main chip covers a thousand units once over and ten thousand not at all; 12 of 22 lines cannot cover ten thousand three times over. This is a question for a factory with purchasing relationships, not a design problem — but it is the reason the cost model's upper quantities should be read as indicative.

risks.r: The spec states no battery-gauge accuracy requirement
risks.d: Found by the availability lane while checking whether ±1 percent resistors were needed. They are affordable, so it no longer gates anything — but the requirement itself is simply absent from SPEC.md, which is a hole rather than a decision. Recorded as CANNOT DETERMINE.
